name: Meralgia Paresthetica
category: Neurology > Peripheral Nerve > Lateral Femoral Cutaneous
definition: Entrapment/irritation of the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve causing sensory symptoms over the anterolateral thigh without motor weakness.

typical: Burning, tingling or numbness over anterolateral thigh
Symptoms worsened by standing/walking or tight garments

redFlags.item: Motor weakness or reflex changes suggesting radiculopathy/femoral neuropathy

core: Motor/reflex exam to exclude root/femoral nerve disease
Tinel near inguinal ligament may be supportive

investigations.MRI: MRI pelvis/lumbar spine only when alternative pathology is suspected.
investigations.radiographs: Electrodiagnostic testing may help atypical cases.

amber: Neuropathic medication, injection or decompression require individualized assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuralgia phenotype can be documented, while the mononeuropathy diagnosis remains explicit.

patientEducation.summary: Entrapment/irritation of the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve causing sensory symptoms over the anterolateral thigh without motor weakness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
